purpose: An evidence-led Texas business research library. Review dates are editorial reminders, not legal deadlines or scheduled jobs.

articles.decision: Commit capital against usable power and operating conditions
triggers: New ERCOT allocation, batch or energization notice
PUCT implementation order or rule
TCEQ audit update and facility permitting change

articles.decision: Choose supply and cooling arrangements that meet peak demand
triggers: TWDB adoption or amendment status changes
Supplier drought stage, contract or delivery evidence changes
Local well, reuse or discharge authority changes

articles.decision: Budget ownership, improvements and lease tax exposure
triggers: Circuit-breaker expiry or amendment
Adopted rate or appraisal notice
Asset situs, ownership, lease or exemption eligibility changes

articles.decision: Underwrite route-specific tax savings and repayment exposure
triggers: Agency form or statutory investment-clock clarification
Certification, registered purchaser or schedule changes
New audit, job, investment or metering evidence

articles.decision: Price an incentive together with its continuing obligations
triggers: Eligibility rule or statutory amendment
Signed agreement, valuation or adopted-rate change
New project reporting or enforcement evidence

articles.decision: Choose supported filing and computation treatment
triggers: Report-year instructions or credit guidance change
Accounting period, group structure or entity status changes
New notice, acceptance or extension evidence

articles.decision: Price role-specific recruiting, compensation and delay
triggers: Next TWC observation or statistical revision
New BLS occupational wage reference period
Actual recruiting, training or retention results diverge

articles.reader: Texas buyers sourcing across the Mexico border
articles.decision: Qualify landed cost, customs and usable receipt
triggers: Bridge hours, fees, customs or commodity rules change
Comparable BTS data observation or correction
Carrier quote, receiving performance or backup-route changes

articles.reader: Buyers and investors assessing Texas manufacturing
articles.decision: Distinguish announcements from buyer-usable qualified output
triggers: Company commissioning, earnings or qualification disclosure
Permitting, award or project-schedule change
New customer allocation or acceptance evidence

articles.decision: Match insured perils and claims terms to cash-at-risk
triggers: TDI or TWIA filing, endorsement or rate effective date
Actual quote, policy, exclusions or valuation changes
Exposure, lender requirement or loss-prevention design changes

articles.reader: Private employers and AI procurement teams
articles.decision: Identify applicable AI, privacy and biometric duties
triggers: Enforcement or governing legal change
Business sandbox intake evidence
Vendor, deployed use, processing relationship or data change

articles.decision: Preserve the bargain and underwrite the dispute scenario
triggers: Appellate treatment or governing procedural change
New contract, release, claim or counterclaim
Official operating division or court reporting update

articles.decision: Choose a usable passenger AV channel and fallback

Onboard role, platform or business payment program changes
Actual trip costs and exception evidence diverge

articles.decision: Approve a journey and compare fare with employee time
triggers: Waymo rider admission, airport or pickup guidance changes
Uber matching or business payment availability changes
Actual travel cohort or fallback evidence changes

articles.decision: Match a commercial commitment to the local fleet stage
triggers: Zoox Texas rider admission or vehicle stage advances
Federal Operational Authorization or exemption conditions change

articles.decision: Shortlist the operator for a defined freight job
triggers: A driver-out launch, onboard role or accepted endpoint changes

Current buyer-specific capacity or recovery evidence changes

articles.decision: Buy a complete route with priced recovery and backup
triggers: Quoted inclusions, price, acceptance or support arrangements change
Actual trial completion, exception and interruption evidence changes
Carrier records or insurance evidence change

articles.decision: Verify operating authority and preserve service continuity
triggers: Governing law, agency rules or enforcement guidance changes
Holder, fleet, responder plan or operating domain changes
Actual interruption, replacement and restart evidence changes
